meta.name: ai-ml-governance
meta.description: Governs models and AI systems in production — intended use, evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, documentation, and the decision to deploy or retire. Use this before deploying a model or AI feature, when defining evaluation criteria, when a model's behavior has drifted, when assessing AI risk or regulatory exposure, or when deciding whether an AI system is fit for a consequential decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规范AI模型治理,把控上线风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责AI系统的合规与风险评估
copy.tagline_en: Govern AI models with clear oversight
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own AI compliance and risk decisions

howto.what: Claude 在你管理 AI 模型时,先帮你写明用途与排除范围,再产出评估、监控、人工监督与文档方案,并提示退役和禁止事项。
howto.when: 当你要部署模型或 AI 功能、定义评估标准,或判断模型是否适合重大决策等治理动作时触发。

say.text: 我要上线这个信贷审批模型,先做治理评估。
say.note: 它会引导定义用途与后果分级。

say.text: 帮我写推荐模型的监控和人工复核方案。
say.note: 覆盖漂移监控与可见性要求。

say.text: 查一下这个 AI 是否合适做这类重大决策。
say.note: 会输出适用性和治理检查结果。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to define intended use and exclusions, then produces evaluation, monitoring, human-oversight, and documentation plans, and points out retirement and prohibited actions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are deploying a model or AI feature, defining evaluation criteria, or judging whether a model is fit for a consequential decision.

say_en.text: I'm launching this credit-scoring model; run a governance review first.
say_en.note: It guides intended use and consequence tier.

say_en.text: Write a monitoring and human-review plan for our recommendation model.
Check whether this AI is suitable for such a consequential decision.
